newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ex-RBA gov Fraser says rate cut chance missed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ex-RBA gov Fraser says rate cut chance missed.

text.p: Former Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Bernie Fraser said on Friday that monetary authorities had missed an opportunity to cut interest rates a fifth time in the past 12 months.
"I believe the opportunity has been missed not to have slipped in a fifth rate cut during this period," Fraser told a building industry luncheon.
He also said Australia needed annual economic growth in the order of four to five percent this financial year and the following year in order to reduce unemployment.
Fraser added that Australia was likely to continue to have a low inflation environment for the next year or two.
Australian interest rates were cut four times between July 1996 and May this year, each time by 0.5 percentage points.
Official rates now stand at 5.5 percent.
Analysts widely expect another cut in official rates later this month or in August after the release next week of second quarter inflation and wages data.
The Reserve Bank board holds its next monthly board meeting on August 5.
